title: Finding changed files for an asset pipeline
notes: Dart 3.13.0 (2026-08-12; CHANGELOG.md at tag 3.13.7 says 'Released on: 2026-08-12', at 3.13.0 it still reads 'Unreleased'). Release note, CHANGELOG.md at 3.13.0, dart:io: '**Behavioral change**: File access and modification timestamps (`File.lastModified`, `FileStat`, `lastAccessed`, `lastModified`, `setLastAccessed`, `setLastModified`) now preserve microsecond precision instead of truncating or rounding to millisecond accuracy. See SDK issue [#42444][].' The naive version stores `modified.millisecondsSinceEpoch` in the manifest and tests `modified.isAfter(DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(prev))`, which is now true for every file on every run, so a second run with nothing touched reports both files. That it passed on Dart 3.12 is shown only by a simulation (timestamps truncated to milliseconds inside naive); no older SDK is installed. On disk, barely: /opt/homebrew/share/flutter/bin/cache/dart-sdk/lib/io/file_system_entity.dart:137-139 and 174-176 build the DateTime with fromMicrosecondsSinceEpoch; no doc comment mentions precision. Exposure risk: very low (dart-lang/sdk issue 42444 fix referenced 2026-06-18, closed 2026-06-22).
